episodes.156295: Interaction between an eastward propagating shortwave over the Gulf of Mexico and a stationary frontal boundary draped across the north/central Florida peninsula produces a MCS with a few strong marine wind gusts over the central coastal waters.
episodes.156297: Convection associated with a slowly southward moving frontal boundary draped across the central Florida peninsula produces a waterspout.
episodes.156980: Clusters of thunderstorms, many containing gusty winds, moved across the east central Florida coast, ahead of a weak cold front. The thunderstorm produced gusty winds over the coastal lagoon and along the near-shore Atlantic as they continued offshore.
episodes.158038: As a result of snowmelt, an ice jam occurred at Anchor Point, and held for several days, causing flooding of Anchor River Road and the nearby campgrounds.
episodes.158152: A strong low pressure system and associated cold front moving across Lake Superior produced storm force northwest wind gusts at Stannard Rock Light on the morning of the 19th.
episodes.158154: Isolated severe thunderstorm associated with a trough of low pressure produced large hail across portions of northeast North Carolina.

events.narrative: Broadcast media relayed viewer submitted video of waterspout near Big Carlos Pass.

An ice jam formed on the lower Anchor River on April 19, 2021.  Originally the ice jam formed above the stream gage on the Old Sterling Highway and over the next few days the ice jam slowly moved downstream until it broke on April 24th.  The area around the Old Sterling Highway flooded - notably the DOT supply and equipment staging site for the bridge replacement this summer as well as the campgrounds along the Anchor River Road and Anchor River Road itself.
